desc:
Open anime card packs, discover rare variants, and build a binder that earns cash—even while you’re offline!

🃏 OPEN packs and hunt for your favorite cards
🌈 DISCOVER rare variants and powerful grades
📖 BUILD a valuable card binder
💰 EARN in-game cash while you’re away
⚔️ BATTLE in Showdowns and test your best cards
🤝 TRADE with other collectors
✨ UPGRADE, craft, and complete your collection
🆕 NEW CARDS every Wednesday and Saturday!

Collect cards from One Piece, Demon Slayer, Naruto, Re:Zero, Frieren, Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan, Sword Art Online, and many more!

🎁 Use code “30M” in-game for a reward!

👍 Like the game and join Nova Digital Games!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, and Console
